title: Test Condition
text: Constrain signal values in test cases, 1 input, 1 output, {Values} sets Test condition scalar; {Enable} sets the whether block is enabled, {Type} sets the whether the block behaves as a Test Condition or Proof Assumption block Test, {Display values} displays the contents of values parameter and {Pass through style (show Outport)} sets the whether block displays an output port in the Simulink. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input signal specified as a scalar or cell array scalar | cell array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output signal returned as a scalar or a cell array scalar | cell array

params.name: Enable
params.values: Whether block is enabled on (default) | off

params.name: Type
params.values: Whether the block behaves as a Test Condition or Proof Assumption block Test Condition (default) | Assumption

params.name: Display values
params.values: Display the contents of values parameter on (default) | off

params.name: Pass through style (show Outport)
params.values: Whether block displays an output port in the Simulink Editor on (default) | off
